laws.name: Oregon Family Leave Act (OFLA)
laws.description: Provides job-protected unpaid leave for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, bereavement, and certain military-related reasons.

laws.name: Oregon Paid Family and Medical Leave (Paid Leave Oregon)
laws.description: Provides paid leave benefits for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and safe leave related to domestic violence, sexual assault, harassment, or stalking.

laws.name: Oregon Sick Time Law
laws.description: Provides paid or unpaid sick time depending on employer size for medical needs, family caregiving, public health emergencies, and safe leave.

laws.name: Oregon Safe Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, harassment, or stalking to seek medical care, legal assistance, counseling, or safety services.

laws.name: Oregon State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Oregon state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Oregon State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Oregon state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
